in_arabic.name: زبرجد
in_arabic.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'زبر' (zabur) meaning 'mountain' or 'elevated place', and the Persian suffix '-jad' meaning 'chief' or 'king'. So, the name 'Zabarjad' means 'Chief of the Mountains' or 'King of the Mountains'.
